notes: Synthetic: authored by hand from the official Anthropic docs (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages, build-with-claude/streaming, build-with-claude/thinking, build-with-claude/extended-thinking, agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool, build-with-claude/handling-stop-reasons, build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback, build-with-claude/citations), read 2026-10-28. Field names, event types and stop reasons are the documented ones; ids, signatures, token counts and text are invented. Replace each case with a recorded capture (source: recorded) when the live recorder runs. Extended thinking is manual here (thinking.type=enabled + budget_tokens; adaptive returns 400 on this model), so request.json carries the thinking param as an extra field the gateway receives. Known gap R1 (request side): translateRequest does not forward thinking (or any other extra field), so the thinking cases' upstream_request.golden.json has no thinking param and extended thinking cannot be enabled through /v1/chat/completions; recording these cases needs an upstream_patch.json (see contracttest/README.md). Streams use the cumulative message_delta usage form from the web-search streaming example. The cited text block in stream_web_search starts as {type:text,text:""} as in the docs; a recording may show a citations key on it.
